Each open_call is closed by a CAUSAL_TERMINAL or an inline causal CALL_RETURN/CALL_EXCEPTION; one call key per observed boundary, including nested perform.
Each parent T/R independent invocation is an observed causal boundary. Each original independent appends at most one ORACLES item after its chain loop.

At most one protocol per observed start/spawn boundary, plus the one exact DI07 direct start.
T/R receives: one recv per observed receive boundary on PASS; Drive receives: one recv per message helper with one assertTrue, including DI07. No instrumented child Store is counted.

Domain declaration originates only from observed Store constructor, owner return with head, or successful Store.transact. Reentrant owner(None) does not generate a head declaration.

At most one nested-call link per call; at most one RETURN_RETAINS_ORACLE and one unique receipt-candidate link per retained oracle. Candidate uniqueness is an observation-validity precondition, not a refs quota.
Only return-retains and receipt-candidate links carry a domain; nested-call link has no domain.

Every witness is first appended by DomainState.declaration; each invocation appends at most one. No row-size/ref limit is used for this source bound.
At most one membership for a given owner ref per frame;321 frames times the global new-owner envelope. Deliberately loose, not an inferred reset/deduplication.
